title: A room detail the hotel's site does not state for any room
why: The traveller needs a bathtub. Casa Halcy's room descriptions mention size, side, bed and view, never a bathtub or a shower. Nothing on the site says any room has one or lacks one, so the agent must not reject every room and must not pass it silently: it has to tell the traveller the site does not say, before the approval card. The scripted traveller then goes on without it; the cheapest cancellable room midweek is the Classic on the Flexible rate.
message: Two of us at Casa Halcy, Tuesday to Thursday next week, cancellable, no breakfast. We need a room with a bathtub.

replies.say: Go on without it, we will ask the hotel.
